messages:
Helena K: Hey team - I received two payslips this cycle: one from Redwood UK and one from Redwood US for the SAME August pay period. I was supposed to transfer to UK payroll starting 2026-08-01. I updated relocation forms and submitted UK payroll onboarding on 07/20.
Zoe (People Ops): Oh no, thanks for flagging. Can you DM both payslip PDFs and confirm your relocation effective date and passport/NI details?
Helena K: DMed both PDFs and the relocation effective date 2026-08-01. UK payroll shows a full gross for Aug and US shows a full gross too.
Ian - Payroll: Looks like a cutover race condition between the US pay feed and the UK onboarding feed. UK vendor ingested the record and processed a UK net pay; meanwhile US payroll didn't receive the termination flag and processed the regular US run.
Helena K: Will this cause double income on my tax filings? I don't want to be taxed twice or have to file two full-year returns unnecessarily.
Ian - Payroll: Short answer: possibly, but we will audit remit activity. If only one jurisdiction received actual remit, we can reverse the duplicate off-cycle. If both remitted, TaxOps will coordinate refunds or treaty relief. We'll need to reconcile grosss, employer NI/PAYE, and US federal/state withholding.
TaxOps Bot: Case TAX-5178 opened: "Payroll cutover duplicate remit - Helena K". Auditor ETA 4 business days.
Zoe (People Ops): For transparency: steps we'll take - 1) Pause any further remits; 2) Run cross-feed audit to see which payroll reported year-to-date wages to HMRC vs IRS/State; 3) If duplicate remits not sent, payroll will reverse duplicate; 4) If remits sent, TaxOps will file refunds or use treaty provisions and we may need to issue W-2 and P60 corrections.
Helena K: Appreciate the steps. If I need to submit any extra documentation to HMRC/IRS for treaty relief, let me know. Also worried about benefit deductions being taken twice (pension/401k).
Ian - Payroll: Good catch - we'll check benefits mapping too. Pension contributions should only apply on the UK payroll once your enrollment synced. 401(k) deferrals may have been applied mistakenly on the US run; if so we'll reverse employee deferral and employer match adjustments accordingly.
PayrollBot: Ticket PR-4788 created by Ian - Payroll: "Duplicate UK/US payrun for Helena K - investigate + reverse". ETA 3 business days for initial reconciliation.
Zoe (People Ops): Helena, we'll keep you updated in this thread. If anything posts (off-cycle, remits, W-2/P60 changes) we'll summarize next steps and any forms you'll need. Sorry for the disruption. :pray:
